column1: 5.5.4.7.1 Description of Field Data Loader. Shakti Field Data Loader (FDL) system
is a laptop based computer system. It is software intensive Human Machine Interface (HMI)
system, for the EW user, for performing FDL related operations such as exchange of files
with Shakti SCD/ RFPS computer and for performing Shakti SCD ‘Offline Mode’
functionalities (Replay, Simulation etc). Refer ‘Human Machine Interface (HMI) Document
Volume 1 - System Controller & Display (SCD)’ for SCD related functionalities in FDL. FDL
application software shall be loaded and executed on FDL computer. The FDL application
shall start automatically on computer system power on.
